method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly). Mostly third-party summaries; US terms not confirmed on Pfizer pages.
overview: Pfizer is a global biopharmaceutical company headquartered in New York. Strategy roles are in-house: corporate and portfolio strategy, commercial strategy and transformation teams.
business_type: In-house strategy at a biopharmaceutical company

differentiators.text: New York headquarters with strategy work tied to drug portfolio and commercial decisions.
differentiators.significance: A route into healthcare strategy; specialised industry knowledge is often expected.

early_career.text: Summaries list development tracks, a mentorship program, tuition reimbursement and continuing education during work hours.

employee_support.text: Summaries list parental and family medical leave (12 weeks for both parents on a non-US page).

flexibility.text: Hybrid model with typically 2-3 on-site days for office roles, with flexibility depending on local leadership (non-US summaries).

sources.title: Built In: Work-life balance at Pfizer (Singapore)
